title: 'Send to their app' says the member will see the payment, even when the member does not use the app
what: On a money sheet the desk can tap 'Send to their app' for any member who owes a fee. The screen then says 'Sent. They see it under My membership in the MettleUp app.' The member only sees it if they have the app and are linked to this gym under the same member. For a member who is not on the app nothing arrives anywhere, and no alert is sent even to members who are. The desk waits for money that is never asked for.
expected: Offer 'Send to their app' only for members who are on the app, or say plainly that this member is not on the app and suggest the payment link or UPI QR instead.
how_often: every time a fee is sent to a member not on the app
fix_line: Show the button only for members linked to the app; otherwise say why it is missing

title: In Hinglish, branches, entry machines, the move notice, the demo gym and the Pro pack note stay in English
what: The payment screens are fully in Hinglish, but the Branches card, All branches, the visitor check-in card, the entry machine guide and messages, the 'MettleUp is moving' notice every desk sees, the demo gym banner and the 'Part of the Pro pack' note are written straight in English and never pass through the language switch. A desk that picked Hinglish reads a mix of both on the same screen.
expected: Every line a desk reads in these screens has a Hinglish version, or the language choice says which screens are English only.
fix_line: Wrap these lines in the language switch and add their Hinglish

title: After adding a branch with a long name, its 'Open' button runs off a phone screen
what: After a branch is added, the button reads 'Open' plus the branch name. Buttons in the admin app are set never to wrap, and a branch name can be up to 60 letters. A name like 'Iron Temple Fitness Studio, Vaishali Nagar Main Road' makes the button wider than a 320 to 390 px phone, so its end is cut off or the page scrolls sideways.
expected: The button wraps onto two lines or reads just 'Open the branch', with the name in the line above it.
who: owners adding a branch on a phone
how_often: each new branch with a long name
fix_line: Let this button wrap, or keep the name out of the button

title: Three controls go grey with no reason on screen
what: 'Save name' for the business name is greyed while the name is unchanged, with no word that it is already saved. 'Test and connect' for a payment company stays grey until every key box is filled, with nothing saying so. The branch picker at the top goes grey with no internet, and the reason is given only to screen readers, not shown.
expected: Next to each greyed control a short line says why: 'Already saved', 'Fill in both keys', 'Needs internet'.
fix_line: Add a one-line reason under each of the three

title: The new-branch tip sends owners to 'Settings, Staff & sign-in', but that page is not in Settings
what: Before adding a branch the owner is told: to add its front-desk staff, pick the branch, then go to Settings, then Staff & sign-in. Settings has only three tabs (Gym, Member app, Sign-in & data). Staff & sign-in is its own entry in the menu next to Settings, so the owner looks in the wrong place.
expected: The tip names the real place: the menu, then Staff & sign-in.
fix_line: Change the tip to name the menu entry

title: Three small lines are clumsy or not quite true
what: The entry machine page says 'MettleUp marks them as come in', which is broken English. The payment switches say 'This switch is not switched on yet. Until then members pay in the app as now', which does not tell the owner what 'as now' means. The visitor check-in limit says 'This desk looked up 30 numbers', but the count is for the whole branch, every desk together, so a desk that looked up two numbers can be told it looked up 30.
expected: 'MettleUp marks them as come in today'; 'Online payments in the app are not ready yet; members pay at the desk or by UPI QR as before'; 'This branch looked up 30 numbers in the last hour'.
